name: RKHS.kerFun_inner
type: {𝕜 X V H : Type*} → [RCLike 𝕜] → [NormedAddCommGroup V] → [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 V] → [NormedAddCommGroup H] → [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 H] → [RKHS 𝕜 H X V] → [CompleteSpace H] → [CompleteSpace V] → (x : X) → (v : V) → (f : H) → inner 𝕜 (RKHS.kerFun H x v) f = inner 𝕜 v (f x)
provides: The reproducing identity; for real scalar-valued functions and v=1 it gives inner(kernel section,f)=f(x).

name: RKHS.OfKernel.kernel_ofKernel
type: {𝕜 X V : Type*} → [RCLike 𝕜] → [NormedAddCommGroup V] → [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 V] → [CompleteSpace V] → {K : Matrix X X (V →L[𝕜] V)} → [Fact K.PosSemidef] → RKHS.kernel (RKHS.OfKernel K) = K
provides: The complete RKHS constructed from a positive semidefinite operator-valued kernel has exactly that kernel; real scalar kernels embed as scalar-multiplication operators.
type_review: Inspected the completion construction, RKHS instance, theorem proof and enclosing OfKernel namespace with its positivity/completeness assumptions; manually expanded type, not compiled.

name: RKHS.equiv
type: {𝕜 X V H H' : Type*} → [RCLike 𝕜] → [NormedAddCommGroup V] → [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 V] → [CompleteSpace V] → [NormedAddCommGroup H] → [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 H] → [CompleteSpace H] → [RKHS 𝕜 H X V] → [NormedAddCommGroup H'] → [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 H'] → [CompleteSpace H'] → [RKHS 𝕜 H' X V] → RKHS.kernel H = RKHS.kernel H' → (H ≃ₗᵢ[𝕜] H')
provides: A linear isometric equivalence between complete RKHSs having the same kernel; the adjacent coe_equiv theorem identifies their underlying functions.
